name: JS SDK (@velexis/ota-sdk)
summary: The OTA booking API's JavaScript client: vanilla ES2022 modules with JSDoc types and no runtime dependencies, one method per x-sdk-method (129 in 8 namespaces), three session modes (cookie, token, server), retries, idempotency keys, typed errors and pagination; used by the hosted storefront, the OTA admin and third-party frontends.
audience: Third-party developers (custom storefronts and servers with pk_/sk_ keys)
OTA admin server code (server mode with the service key, ota/admin)
Velexis maintainers (contract, route table, tests, release)
Owner (approves the npm publish workflow and licence)
stack: ES2022 modules, no runtime dependencies (fetch, Headers, URL, AbortController, crypto, FormData, Blob)
JSDoc types checked by tsc --checkJs --strict (TypeScript 5.6.3), types from @velexis/api-types
Route table generated from the OTA OpenAPI document (scripts/generate-operations.mjs)
esbuild 0.25.12: ESM bundle + IIFE (window.Velexis), 25 KB min+gzip budget
Vitest 4.1.12 (unit, contract, bundle, package, smoke), happy-dom 21 for cookie mode
Node.js 22.12+ and 24, evergreen browsers, edge runtimes

local.notes: A library: nothing to start. Unit and contract tests run offline against a fake fetch; build with pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk build (dist/velexis-sdk.mjs, dist/velexis-sdk.iife.js, dist/types). Smoke tests (test:smoke) call a running OTA API on http://127.0.0.1:4000 with the three keys the OTA backend's dev:seed printed. The storefront (Vite) and the OTA admin use src/ through the development export condition.

production.host: npm package @velexis/ota-sdk 1.0.0 (not yet published; owner approval pending); clients call api.ota.example.com or /api on a storefront host

talksTo.how: HTTPS fetch to the booking API: X-Api-Key, Authorization: Bearer, X-Booking-Token, X-CSRF-Token (cookie mode), X-Velexis-Environment (console), Idempotency-Key, If-Match
Embedded in the browser in cookie mode: one client (src/lib/client.js), same-origin /api, derived clients via withOptions
Embedded server-side in server mode: OTA_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY, staff access token, sessionKind staff, environment (src/lib/velexis.ts)
Types only from @velexis/api-types (copied into dist/types/api-types.d.ts at build); dev dependencies @velexis/config and @velexis/testing
Nightly e2e workflow runs test:smoke after the Playwright stacks; tools/ci/sdk-draft-pins.test.mjs checks the publish draft's pins

data: No tables of its own and no browser storage: the SDK keeps tokens in memory only (cookie mode keeps none)

Reaches through the OTA API: platform.api_keys (key checks), tenant_<key>.customers, customer_sessions, flight_searches, flight_offers, priced_offers, checkouts, payments, bookings, booking_access_tokens, idempotency_keys and every table of the console operations
Redis touched by its calls: apikey:<prefix>, apikey:used:<keyId>, rl:<throttler>:<tracker>, staffsess:<familyId>; the smoke test writes ptk:<sha256>
Cookies it relies on in cookie mode: __Host-vx_csrf (read), __Host-vx_at, __Host-vx_rt, __Host-vx_bt (httpOnly, never read)

roles.name: Hosted storefront (cookie mode)
roles.can: Customer operations on its own origin with session cookies and CSRF; no key or token in JavaScript; the only caller of checkout.completeWithAirlineCard

roles.name: Third-party browser app (token mode, pk_)
roles.can: Customer-scope operations from origins listed on the key; holds tokens itself; console refused (403 SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED)

roles.name: Third-party server (server mode, sk_ scoped storefront)
roles.can: Customer operations for its visitors with endUser; console refused (storefront_key)

roles.name: Custom console / automation (sk_ console:automation)
roles.can: Console operations listed in the key's permissions, or any the signed-in staff member's role allows with a staff token

roles.name: OTA admin server (service key)
roles.can: Every console operation with a staff token and X-Velexis-Environment; nothing customer-scoped
